messages:
maria: quick FYI — i'm opening a PR to add a new arm-based gpu nodepool (g5g) for cheaper inference runs. planning: reserved capacity in 2 AZs + a small spot fallback pool. pinging infra for config sanity check
ben: nice. can you share the tf snippet you plan to apply? want to confirm capacity reservation fields and AMI bootstrap bits
maria: yup, snippet in PR but pasting key part here:
```hcl
resource \"aws_launch_template\" \"g5g_lt\" {
  # ...
  capacity_reservation_specification {
    capacity_reservation_preference = \"open\"    # prefer open reservations, target reserved by AZ in autoscaler
  }
  user_data = base64encode(templatefile(\"user-data.sh.tpl\", {kms_key = var.kms_key}))
}
```
lucy: two quick notes: 1) make sure g5g has driver DaemonSet gated on arm64 images, 2) we need node labels for scheduling (e.g., \"gpu.arch=arm64\" and \"gpu.type=g5g\")
sanjay: for spot fallback, please add taints so only tolerant workloads go there. something like:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  labels:
    node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: g5g.xlarge
  taints:
  - key: \"gpu.spot\"
    value: \"true\"
    effect: \"NoSchedule\"
```
maria: good call. i'm also wiring secrets for the node bootstrap to SSM so AMI doesn't bake creds. using instance profile with ssm:GetParameters and kms:Decrypt. is that the preferred pattern?
ben: yes, IAM role+SSM is what we use for other pools. make sure the role is limited to the param path `\/infra\/nodes\/g5g\/*` and document rotate plan. also add a check in the TF module that `associate_public_ip` is explicit (we ran into broken user-data when implicit)
lucy: small ops concern: capacity reservations across AZs can be expensive. can the autoscaler prefer reserve but fall back to on-demand (not spot) before spot? we had latency spikes when spot preempted workloads mid-batch
maria: autoscaler policy we discussed: prefer reserved -> on-demand -> spot. i'll add routingPolicy in the nodepool CRD: `preferredCapacity: [reserved, on_demand, spot]`
sanjay: code-review ping @ben @lucy — PR 4923. main changes: tf launch template + asg changes + nodepool CRD + daemonset tweaks.
infra-bot: terraform plan for branch gpu/g5g-pool (PR 4923) finished: 
- create 3 resources
- change 1 resource

ben: 👀 will look today. curious about eviction grace: please set kubelet eviction threshold higher for arm nodes (we hit oomkill on small batches). i usually set `--eviction-hard=imagefs.available<5%` and `--eviction-soft=memory.available<200Mi` for GPU nodes
lucy: also add a readiness probe in the node-driver-setup so new nodes don't join the scheduler until drivers are healthy
maria: will update PR with those knobs. one logistics Q — do we want QA to test with a cached kv prefix? caching reduces tokens but might hide perf issues. propose we test with both cached and cold-start runs
sanjay: agreed. schedule a short runbook test next Tue 09:30 PT? i'll book a 30m slot and invite SRE + infra + ml-eng
maria: thanks — i'll add playbook steps to PR description and link perf dashboard once available
ben: LGTM on approach, will leave final approve after infra checks pass
lucy: thanks all. @maria make sure the AMI baking job includes the arm64 nvidia runtime artifacts or add an init container to install them at boot
infra-bot: deploy-checklist updated for nodepool-type=g5g
